data.name: The Last Light
data.intro: A storm is coming. The lighthouse is dark, and a boat is still out beyond the reef.

rooms.name: The Rainward Quay
rooms.description: Salt hangs in the air. A solitary keeper watches the black water beneath the silent tower.

rooms.name: The Keeper’s Workshop
rooms.description: A cluttered room of brass tools, weather charts and an empty lens cradle.

rooms.name: The Lantern Room
rooms.description: The great lamp waits above the sea, its shutter jammed and its lens mount empty.

actions.label: Inspect the sea
actions.text: A single lantern rocks beyond the reef. Someone is waiting for the beacon.
actions.journal: A boat is stranded beyond the reef.

actions.label: Keeper: ask how to help
actions.text: Mara presses a brass key into your hand. ‘The workshop has the lens. The lamp needs a clear lens and an open shutter.’
actions.journal: Mara says the lamp needs a clear lens and an open shutter.

actions.label: Keeper: ask why the light failed
actions.text: Mara flinches. ‘I closed the shutter when the mechanism jammed. I was afraid I would break it.’ She hands you the workshop key.
actions.journal: The shutter jammed; Mara closed it to protect the mechanism.

actions.label: Speak with Mara
actions.text: ‘The old log in the workshop explains the shutter. Please bring them home.’

actions.label: Unlock the workshop
actions.text: The key turns. The workshop door opens.

actions.label: Inspect the keeper’s log
actions.text: The log reads: ‘Release the brass catch before raising the shutter. Never force the wheel.’
actions.journal: Release the brass catch before raising the shutter.

actions.label: Take the clouded lens
actions.text: You lift the clouded lens from its cradle.

actions.label: Take the polishing cloth
actions.text: A soft cloth, still dry beneath the bench.

actions.label: Combine lens + cloth
actions.text: You polish away the salt until the glass holds the light.

actions.label: Climb to the lantern room
actions.text: You climb the narrow iron stairs.

actions.label: Inspect the lamp
actions.text: The mount is empty. A brass catch holds the shutter closed.

actions.label: Release the brass catch
actions.text: Following the log, you ease the catch free.

actions.label: Raise the shutter
actions.text: The shutter rises without a sound. The sea appears through the glass.

actions.label: Install the polished lens
actions.text: The lens settles into its brass mount.

actions.label: Light the beacon
actions.text: The lamp blooms. Its beam crosses the reef, and the boat answers with a lantern. Mara’s voice rises from below: ‘They can see us!’
actions.journal: The beacon shines again. The boat can find its way home.

victory.title: Chapter complete · The light returns
victory.epilogue: The beacon guides the boat safely home. You can keep exploring, load a save, or start over.
